issuing_body: Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD)
embed_context: Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) voluntary sustainability reporting framework. Covers climate risk governance, strategy, risk management, and metrics and targets disclosures for investors.

description: Environmental Reporting Guidelines: Including Streamlined Energy and Carbon Reporting (SECR) Guidance
issuing_body: Department for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy (BEIS)
embed_context: Streamlined Energy and Carbon Reporting (SECR) — mandatory UK sustainability and environmental reporting obligation for large companies and LLPs. Covers who must report, qualifying thresholds (250+ employees, £36m+ turnover, or £18m+ balance sheet), scope 1 and 2 emissions, energy consumption, and Directors' Report disclosure requirements.

description: Procurement Policy Note 06/21: Taking Account of Carbon Reduction Plans in the Procurement of Major Government Contracts
embed_context: UK government procurement requirement: suppliers bidding on major government contracts above £5 million must provide a Carbon Reduction Plan demonstrating net zero commitment by 2050 and sustainability reporting on current emissions.

description: PPN 06/21 Technical Standard for the Completion of Carbon Reduction Plans
embed_context: Technical standard for completing Carbon Reduction Plans required by UK government procurement policy PPN 06/21. Specifies format, emissions scope coverage, and sustainability reporting requirements for supplier carbon disclosures.
